description: This file contains unit tests for the MediaPipeline component, specifically testing the load functionality of the media pipeline in a client context. It defines a test class derived from a base test class, sets up and tears down media pipeline instances, and includes two test cases to verify success and failure scenarios of the load operation via IPC mock expectations.

classes.name: RialtoClientMediaPipelineLoadTest
classes.description: A test fixture class for testing the load functionality of the media pipeline client, derived from MediaPipelineTestBase.

methods.name: SetUp
methods.description: Initializes the test environment, sets up the media pipeline before each test.

methods.name: TearDown
methods.description: Cleans up the test environment, destroys the media pipeline after each test.
